{{Quote|Well, only a few here would have known about the weapons and flight schedule that Donovan was working. One of our agents is missing and has not been seen since you started uncovering this. His name is Jori and we now believe he sold us out to the Ragtags and Deflarians--he must be found.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jark]], to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:LtBB" />}}
'''Jori''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agent turned criminal who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Now kill two Deflarian agents and that traitor Jori. Before he left, he stole vital information about our city defense capabilities. It is most likely he will have it on him. Retrieve it and bring it to me.|Captain Jark, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LtBB" />}}
[[File:Ragtags_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Ragtag/Deflarian meeting.]]
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jori was an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:LtBB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jori betrayed the CorSec by selling out to the [[Deflarians]] and [[Ragtags]]. He gave information concerning a cargo of weapons carried by CorSec [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Donovan (captain)|Donovan]] to the criminals. The Deflarians hijacked the ship to steal the weapons and sell them to the Ragtags, and captured Captain Donovan. After [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Cora (Human)|Cora]] and a spacer rescued Donovan, CorSec Captain [[Jark]] sent the spacer to raid a meeting between Deflarians and Ragtags. Jori was killed during the operation and the CorSec managed to retrieve vital information about [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] defense capabilities provided by the traitor to the Ragtags.<ref name="SWG:LtBB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateMercenaryElite.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Jori]]
Jori was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LtBB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jori was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> His appearance was randomly generated, but the quest dialogue identified him as a male.<ref name="SWG:LtBB" />
